policy: Release is blocked by any open P0 or P1 issue. P2 issues require owner, target month, and accepted-risk notes.

issues.title: Invite-only beta still needs broader representative trip coverage beyond current automated fixtures
issues.acceptedRisk: Current release-candidate gates prove the launch fixture matrix, regional generated actuals, Athens public share, multi-itinerary public-share flows, production health, guest accessibility, and production visual review. The prompt contract now enforces 60 representative fixtures across friend groups, couples, families, solo travelers, budget, premium, food, nightlife, outdoors, culture, and six regions. The 25-trip beta-representative generated-actuals evidence is attached, map hydration is exercised before readback, wrong-country fallback pins are rejected, and the prompt-suite cross-check passes with 25 generated actuals. The remaining beta phase is now operationalized by qa/beta-human-review-register.json and npm run qa:beta-review-readiness, which validates a 25-review intake matrix across audience, style, region, device, and journey-surface coverage. qa/beta-human-review-packet-manifest-2026-05-21.json and qa/beta-human-review-packets-2026-05-21/ now provide reviewer-ready assignments for all 25 planned reviews, and launch signoff verifies that packet coverage. Public launch still needs at least 25 completed real or representative human reviews with zero unresolved P0/P1 findings.

issues.title: Production visual-diff review cadence should mature from artifact capture to routine human review
issues.acceptedRisk: Automated visual gates currently fail on overflow, app errors, clipped text, overlap, and selected pixel diffs. Launch signoff now requires a fresh production visual review register that tracks the live production commit and deployment URL, verifies reviewed screenshots exist for every production visual result, confirms required public routes and stable diff routes, and records owner, cadence, next review date, protocol, verdict, and blocking findings. Public-launch signoff mode additionally requires four distinct production visual-review history entries with passing evidence. The P2 remains open until this cadence has routine human review history through beta and scale rehearsal.
